mainEntity.name: Why does citizenship eligibility matter in a naturalisation matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: In client terms, citizenship issues usually depend on legal category, residence history, documentary continuity, and the precise statutory route being used. In real cases, citizenship eligibility changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
